name: Find Forms
description: List Google Form documents or search for a Form by name. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/search-files) for more information

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: folderId
configurable_props.label: Parent Folder
configurable_props.description: The ID of the parent folder which contains the file. If not specified, it will list files from the drive's top-level folder.

configurable_props.name: queryAlert
configurable_props.content: If no query or search name is specified, all forms in the selected drive/folder will be returned.

configurable_props.name: nameSearchTerm
configurable_props.label: Search Name
configurable_props.description: Search for a file by name (equivalent to the query `name contains [value]`).

configurable_props.name: searchQuery
configurable_props.label: Search Query
configurable_props.description: Search for a file with a query. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/guides/ref-search-terms) for more information. If specified, `Search Name` and `Parent Folder` will be ignored.
